changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwuomgroupunit AS SELECT ugu.id, ugu.uom, ugu.uom_order, ugu.uom_group_id FROM public.uom_group_unit ugu;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwuomgroupunit TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwuomgroupunit FROM report_user;
